body:
Thank you for reporting. However this is a duplicate of an already reported issue. We prefer to track issues in one place, so I am consolidating this with:
* https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/86691

See the linked issue for details. If you think it may not be the same and we missed something, please comment here and this issue can be reopened.
Well, if you think this is the same as that other one, I'll subscribe to it so I can monitor what becomes of it, and check if this one disappears when it does.
If it's not please say so and this can be reopened, but with the information provided it sounds like the same issue (it's hard to tell without a stack trace showing the function names)

With a bit of work I've got a debug downloaded from https://github.com/Calinou/godot-debug-builds/releases and running on Windows.  The project has to be run from a PCK file since it is not the editor that crashes.

`Animation::get_length()` is at https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/4.3/scene/resources/animation.cpp#L3703 and called from `AnimationPlayer::get_current_animation_length()` 
 https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/4.3/scene/animation/animation_player.cpp#L639  

Therefore I believe that `playback.current.from->animation` is an invalid pointer.  

It also crashes on 4.4dev3.  

I don't think this issue should be closed. @AThousandShips
Will need some further testing then, not sure what differs between the two cases from your description but will see what the animation team says

Tested. I was able to reproduce the issue in v4.3.stable and v4.4.dev3 but not v4.4.dev4, v4.4.stable or v4.5.dev2
